title: DLSS 5 leaked and modders are putting Nvidia’s AI effects on everything
summary: Modders are trying out an unofficial version of Nvidia's DLSS 5 on Skyrim, Cyberpunk 2077, GTA V, and a bunch of other games after code for the AI upscaling tech appeared in an early-access build of NBA 2K27.
